info.title: API.SH: Magic Eden
info.description: The Magic Eden API from API.SH: public Magic Eden data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A collection's activity feed, newest first: sales, listings, delistings, bids and pool updates with time, price (SOL), mint, buyer and seller wallets, marketplace source and transaction signature. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-activities

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only this activity type (buyNow, list, delist, bid, cancelBid, poolUpdate ...); filters within the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Solana NFT collection on Magic Eden: floor price, listed count, 24-hour average sale price, 7-day and all-time volume (SOL), and every trait value with its listed count and floor. With `details=true`, `stats` adds 24-hour and 30-day volume, sales counts for 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, 7- and 30-day average prices, the 7-day floor change, the highest collection offer, the floor NFT, unique holders and total supply.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-collection

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Collection symbol, the name in magiceden.io/marketplace/<symbol>.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: true: also return `stats` (24 h / 30 d volume and sales, average prices, floor change, highest offer, holders, supply). Default false.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Magic Eden collection's total supply, unique holders and holder ratio, plus its top traders by all-time volume (wallet, volume in SOL, last trade).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-holders

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Top traders to return, up to 100 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A collection's NFTs for sale: mint, price (SOL), seller, expiry, HowRare and MoonRank rarity ranks, name, image and traits. Filter by price range and traits, sorted by price or listing time. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-listings

parameters.name: traits
parameters.description: trait:value pairs separated by ; (e.g. Fur:Lofi;Hat:Book); the same trait twice matches either value.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Offers on Magic Eden: with `mint`, the offers received by one NFT (price, buyer, expiry); with `symbol`, the collection's bidding pools (spot price, curve, SOL on the buy side, NFTs on the sell side, owner), highest first. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-offers

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Collection symbol or link (collection bids). Use this or mint.

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: One NFT's mint address (offers on it).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One NFT by mint address: name, collection, owner wallet, image, traits, royalty, listing price and status, and its latest activity (sales, listings, bids).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-token

parameters.name: mint
parameters.description: Solana mint address of the NFT.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Solana wallet on Magic Eden: the NFTs it holds (mint, name, collection, image, traits, royalty, listing price and status) with listed/unlisted and collection filters, its activity (sales, listings, bids, pool updates with price, counterparty and signature), and its bidding escrow balance in SOL. `page` and `limit` page both lists; `tokens_has_more` and `activities_has_more` say which list continues, and `next_page` is null when neither does.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magiceden-wallet

parameters.name: list_status
parameters.description: Which held NFTs to return: both (default), listed, unlisted.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Only NFTs of this collection symbol, e.g. `okay_bears`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only activity of this type, e.g. `buyNow`, `list`, `delist`, `bid`, `cancelBid`, `poolUpdate` (filters the page read, so a page can hold fewer than `limit`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: NFTs and activities per page (default 100, max 500).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
